name: Pleasanton Leader in Training (LIT)
org: City of Pleasanton Library and Recreation, Youth and Teens Office
what_you_do: Teens get job skills training, then volunteer and job shadow with city summer programs: Drama Camp, Gingerbread Preschool Summer Camp, Ridge Runners or Summer Day Camp.
who_can_apply: Students entering 9th or 10th grade in the fall. You must commit to at least two weeks in a row of volunteering in June or July, attend an April orientation and a summer training, and be fingerprinted.
duration: At least 2 weeks of volunteering in June to July. Day length varies by program area.
deadline_text: The 2026 application is closed. The city says to check back in January 2027 for 2027 information. No 2027 dates are posted yet.
how_to_apply: Watch the city page in January 2027 for the application. Questions: Francesca Kelly, FKelly@cityofpleasantonca.gov, or the Youth and Teens Office at (925) 931-3435.
notes: The page does not mention a fee or pay. It does not say if you must live in Pleasanton. Last year's application window was not posted, so the January 2027 note is the only timing clue.
